regulations.occupancy_limits: twice the number of permitted sleeping rooms plus 4, maximum 12
regulations.notes: Nashville requires a permit for all STRs. There are two permit types: owner-occupied and non-owner-occupied. Non-owner-occupied permits are only allowed in commercial/mixed-use zones (MUN, MUL, MUG, MUI, OG, CN, CL, CS, CA, CF, DTC, SC districts) and are prohibited in residential zones (AR2A, R, RS, RM). Initial application fee is $150; annual renewal is $120. Occupancy is capped at twice the number of sleeping rooms plus 4, with a maximum of 12 guests.
